fields.summary_ko.0: Broadcom (AVGO -12.19%) fell ~27% from June high of $481.57 to current $353, with potential to reach $600 by 2030 (14% annual growth), driven mainly by AI semiconductor business expansion.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 AI semiconductor revenue increased 221% YoY to $16.7B; Q4 target of $21.7B (236% growth) with full-year ~$58B expected by 2026 and 2027 AI revenue targeted at ~$115B, doubling 2027 sales.
